sentences.text:
Shri Akhilendra Singh - Government Advocate for the res
of M.P. Ms. Sanjana Yadav - Advocate for complainant.
Learned Government Advocate adopts his previous objection.
The appeal is formally admitted for final hearing.
Record of the trial Court is already received.

Heard on I.A.No.27573 of 2023 application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Sunil Ahirwar arising out of judgment dated 22.03.2022 delivered in SPL Case No.15/2019 passed by Special Judge (POCSO), Tikamgarh District Tikamgarh.
The appellant has been convicted under Section 376(1) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I for 20 years with fine of Rs.10,000/- with default stipulations.

Learned counsel for the appellant while pressing the application for suspension of sentence of the appellant submits that the determination of age of victim as 17 years and 6 months by the trial Court is erroneous.
The parents of victim and the record suggest otherwise.
The factual matrix and evidence on record shows that victim on her own volition stayed with the appellant for quite some time.
It is a case of consent.
Appellant has been falsely implicated in this case and he remained in custody for more than two years.
There is no possibility of early hearing of this appeal in near future.
Thus, remaining jail sentence of the present appellant may be suspended.
The prayer is opposed by learned Government Counsel and submits that the DNA report is positive.
Shri R.S Patel submits that the prosecution witnesses did not support the case of the prosecution.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the objector candidly stated that the victim/prosecutrix has no objection, if jail sentence is suspended.

Considering the aforesaid factual backdrop and bleak chances of final hearing in near future,
without expressing any conclusive opinion on the merits of the case, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 27573 of 2023 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited), the remaining jail sentence of this appellant is hereby suspended and it is directed that appellant - Sunil Ahirwar be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the trial Court, Tikamgarh District Tikamgarh on 22.04.2024 and also on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
Certified copy as per Rules.

(SUJOY PAUL)
